text_block_list.text: —Summer, scorching heat. Even Jungle Pocket, who is usually tireless—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's so hot... So sluggish...
Can't take this crap...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Down, I gotta sit down. No way I can stay standing.
I just can't deal with the heat at all.
She was sprawled out on the ground at the training lodge, looking like a beaten-up thug.
choice_data_list: Drink this and stand back up.
Drink this and get back on your feet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, juice... Thanks...
(Slurp, shluuuurp...)
choice_data_list: Eat this and stand back up!
Eat this and get back on your feet!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, ice cream, so good...

...There was no sign of them getting up.
The food and drinks were swallowed up into the ground,
one after another.
And then night fell—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer.
It vanished. The mark of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's Tachyon. Until now, settling things with
her was my top priority. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tachyon won't be ahead of me anymore. I've lost my guiding light.
choice_data_list: You're right. In that case, it's a bit early, but...
Yeah. It's a bit early, but then...

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should start preparing for future goals earlier.
For the opponent waiting beyond the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Is that that guy?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O!
Back-to-back victories in the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
She remains unstoppable this year!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, the year may have changed,
but I still cannot surrender the throne!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Ah! In their fierce yearning to defeat me,
even Doto and Top Road-san have grown this powerful!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O... Even this year,
her monstrous strength hasn't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "She's a totally different beast from Tachyon. No matter how many hundreds, how many thousands of times I challenge her, she ain't ever gonna fall."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That toughness might actually be a bit like mine.

Her running is solid, and her spirit is strong.
However, the opponent far surpasses her in prestige and track record.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that guy's... seriously crazy dangerous.
Which makes 'em the absolute best target.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All right, first up is the Kikuka Sho! With our sights set on Opera O beyond that, let's do this, partner!

"The opponent couldn't be any more formidable.
Yet Jungle Pocket began aiming to become the strongest across all generations."
